ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest help-desk-driven MFA reset → out-of-band sign-in chain
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature initial access: vishing the help desk to reset/re-register a victim's MFA factor (or password), then signing in from a *different* IP within hours. This is the documented Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Muddled Libra / Storm-0875) playbook against Okta, Entra ID and downstream SaaS, used in the MGM, Caesars and Twilio-style intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as mfa_change_time values(Authentication.signature) as change_type values(Authentication.src) as change_src values(Authentication.action_user) as change_actor FROM datamodel=Authentication WHERE Authentication.app IN ("azure_ad","Microsoft Entra ID","Office 365","Okta") (Authentication.signature IN ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User started security info registration","Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update authentication phone method","Disable Strong Authentication","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.mfa.factor.update","user.mfa.factor.deactivate","user.account.reset_password","system.mfa.factor.activate")) BY Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user | join type=inner user [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as logon_time values(Authentication.src) as logon_src values(Authentication.user_agent) as logon_user_agent values(Authentication.app) as logon_app FROM datamodel=Authentication WHERE Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app IN ("azure_ad","Microsoft Entra ID","Office 365","Okta") BY Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user ] | where logon_time > mfa_change_time AND (logon_time - mfa_change_time) < 14400 AND logon_src != change_src | eval minutes_after_change=round((logon_time - mfa_change_time)/60,0) | table user, change_type, change_actor, change_src, mfa_change_time, logon_app, logon_src, logon_user_agent, logon_time, minutes_after_change | sort - mfa_change_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowHours = 4h;
let HelpDeskActions = dynamic(["Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User started security info registration","Reset user password","Update authentication phone method","Register security info","Disable Strong Authentication","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.mfa.factor.update","user.mfa.factor.deactivate","user.account.reset_password","system.mfa.factor.activate"]);
let MfaChanges = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Microsoft Azure Active Directory","Microsoft Entra ID","Office 365","Okta")
    | where ActionType in~ (HelpDeskActions)
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(ObjectName))
    | project MfaChangeTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn,
              ActorUpn = AccountDisplayName, ActorObjectId = AccountObjectId,
              ChangeIP = IPAddress, ChangeCountry = CountryCode,
              ChangeType = ActionType, IsAdminOperation;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ErrorCode == 0 and IsInteractive == true
| extend AccountUpnLower = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MfaChanges on $left.AccountUpnLower == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (MfaChangeTime .. MfaChangeTime + WindowHours)
| where IPAddress != ChangeIP
| where AccountUpn !endswith "$"
| extend MinutesAfterChange = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, MfaChangeTime)
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, DeviceName, Browser, UserAgent, Application,
          MfaChangeTime, MinutesAfterChange, ChangeType, ActorUpn, ChangeIP, ChangeCountry, IsAdminOperation,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by Timestamp desc

let HelpDeskOps = dynamic(["Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User started security info registration","Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update authentication phone method","Register security info","Disable Strong Authentication","Set force change user password","Add authentication method","Delete authentication method"]);
let MfaChanges = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where LoggedByService in~ ("Authentication Methods","Core Directory","Account Provisioning")
         or Category in~ ("UserManagement","AuthenticationMethod")
    | where OperationName has_any (HelpDeskOps)
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ActorUpn = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project MfaChangeTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ActorUpn, ActorIp, ChangeType = OperationName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ResultType == 0 and IsInteractive == true
| extend UpnLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner MfaChanges on $left.UpnLower == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (MfaChangeTime .. MfaChangeTime + WindowHours)
| where IPAddress != ActorIp
| extend MinutesAfterChange = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, MfaChangeTime)
| extend SignInCountry = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), SignInCity = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, SignInCountry, SignInCity, UserAgent, AppDisplayName,
          MfaChangeTime, MinutesAfterChange, ChangeType, ActorUpn, ActorIp,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM-tool cluster + ngrok/Cloudflared tunnel install on a single host
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature post-access foothold: stacking multiple commodity RMM agents (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Atera, Syncro, Pulseway, NinjaRMM, Action1, TacticalRMM, Fleetdeck, Level.io, TeamViewer) plus a reverse tunnel (ngrok / cloudflared / chisel / frpc / localxpose / rsocx) on the same endpoint within a short window — UNC3944's documented persistence pattern that has bypassed AV in real intrusions because every binary is signed and legitimate.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Processes.process_name) as tools values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_tools count FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop_streamer.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe","atera-agent.exe","atera_agent_64.exe","atera_setup.exe","syncro.installer.exe","syncrolive.exe","pulseway.exe","pulsewaymanager.exe","ninjarmm.exe","ninjarmmagent.exe","ninjarmmagentpatcher.exe","action1_agent.exe","action1_remote.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level-windows-amd64.exe","level.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe","logmein.exe","lmiignition.exe","bomgar-scc.exe","bgsupportagent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","chisel.exe","frpc.exe","gost.exe","rsocx.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*ngrok tcp*","*ngrok http*","*ngrok authtoken*","*cloudflared tunnel*","*cloudflared service install*","*screenconnect.com*","*atera.com*","*syncromsp.com*","*pulseway.com*","*ninjarmm.com*","*action1.com*","*fleetdeck.io*","*level.io*")) BY Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=4h | rename Processes.* as * | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") AND (distinct_tools >= 2 OR match(mvjoin(tools,","), "(?i)(ngrok|cloudflared|chisel|frpc|gost|localxpose|rsocx)\.exe")) | eval rmm_summary=mvjoin(tools,", ") | sort - firstSeen | table firstSeen, lastSeen, dest, user, distinct_tools, rmm_summary, cmdlines, parents
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe",
    "connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop_streamer.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe",
    "atera-agent.exe","atera_agent_64.exe","atera_setup.exe","syncro.installer.exe","syncrolive.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","pulsewaymanager.exe","ninjarmm.exe","ninjarmmagent.exe","ninjarmmagentpatcher.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","action1_remote.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe",
    "fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level-windows-amd64.exe","level.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "logmein.exe","lmiignition.exe","bomgar-scc.exe","bgsupportagent.exe"]);
let TunnelBinaries = dynamic(["ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","chisel.exe","frpc.exe","gost.exe","rsocx.exe"]);
let TunnelCmdMarkers = dynamic(["ngrok tcp","ngrok http","ngrok authtoken","cloudflared tunnel","cloudflared service install","--remote=127.0.0.1","-R 127.0.0.1"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
         or FileName in~ (TunnelBinaries)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (TunnelCmdMarkers)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("screenconnect.com","atera.com","syncromsp.com","pulseway.com","ninjarmm.com","action1.com","fleetdeck.io","level.io"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("sccm.exe","ccmexec.exe","intune.management.exe","setupwm.exe")  // strip MDM/SCCM pushes if applicable
| extend ToolCategory = case(FileName in~ (TunnelBinaries) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (TunnelCmdMarkers), "Tunnel", "RMM")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Tools = make_set(FileName, 50),
            DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            ToolCategories = make_set(ToolCategory),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            SampleParents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            SHA256s = make_set(SHA256, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 4h)
| where DistinctTools >= 2 or ToolCategories has "Tunnel"
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe",
    "connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop_streamer.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe",
    "atera-agent.exe","atera_agent_64.exe","atera_setup.exe","syncro.installer.exe","syncrolive.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","pulsewaymanager.exe","ninjarmm.exe","ninjarmmagent.exe","ninjarmmagentpatcher.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","action1_remote.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe",
    "fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level-windows-amd64.exe","level.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "logmein.exe","lmiignition.exe","bomgar-scc.exe","bgsupportagent.exe"]);
let TunnelBinaries = dynamic(["ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","chisel.exe","frpc.exe","gost.exe","rsocx.exe"]);
let TunnelCmdMarkers = dynamic(["ngrok tcp","ngrok http","ngrok authtoken","cloudflared tunnel","cloudflared service install"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcLower = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcLower in~ (RmmBinaries) or ProcLower in~ (TunnelBinaries)
   or CommandLine has_any (TunnelCmdMarkers)
   or CommandLine has_any ("screenconnect.com","atera.com","syncromsp.com","pulseway.com","ninjarmm.com","action1.com","fleetdeck.io","level.io")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ToolCategory = case(ProcLower in~ (TunnelBinaries) or CommandLine has_any (TunnelCmdMarkers), "Tunnel", "RMM")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Tools = make_set(ProcLower, 50),
            DistinctTools = dcount(ProcLower),
            ToolCategories = make_set(ToolCategory),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            SampleParents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 4h)
| where DistinctTools >= 2 or ToolCategories has "Tunnel"
| order by FirstSeen desc

| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ImageBaseName := regex("\\\\([^\\\\]+\\.exe)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false)
